subject: Business Models
title: Marquee Users
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Marquee Users.

hook.text: Apple paid developers millions to create exclusive iPhone apps at launch. Quality over quantity.

buildup.text: Marquee users are high-profile early adopters whose presence alone attracts the masses.

discovery.text: Clubhouse gave early access to celebrities like Elon Musk. His presence drew millions of signups.

twist.text: Marquee users can also leave loudly. When celebrities abandoned Clubhouse, growth cratered.

climax.text: Marquee users accelerate the chicken-and-egg solution but create fragile dependence on individuals.

punchline.text: One famous user draws millions. But fame is fleeting.

quiz.question: What risk do marquee users create for platforms?
